title: Signal: Workspace allows every dependency to run install scripts
scope: A pnpm-workspace.yaml file that declares a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts.
limitations: It matches a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts in the parsed pnpm-workspace.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pnpm-workspace.yaml that mentions a pnpm workspace that does not restrict which dependencies may run build scripts in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
